clause.quote: A [[ref: Validator]] that receives a key event or non-key-event message that does not have attached at least one verifiable Controller signature MUST drop that message (i.e., not escrow or otherwise accept it).

spec_conflicts.quote: A Validator MAY drop any provided key event message body that does not have at least one attached signature from the current controlling key state of the AID of the associated [[ref: KEL]].
spec_conflicts.why: Line 541 makes dropping an unsigned key event a MAY; line 1266 makes it a MUST. The cases follow line 1266, the later and more specific sentence.

description: A single-key inception signed by its key, with the signature indexed 5 against a one-key list. An index names a position in the key list, and position 5 holds no key, so the signature verifies against nothing; the inception carries no verifiable controller signature and a validator must drop it (lines 1258 and 1266).
title: Inception whose only signature is indexed past its key list
